text:
QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`) makes a fixed-size heap from a caller buffer. It installs its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free` through the same `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` setter."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter from its init function, but never says it is the only in-tree user of the setter, which the item requires.
